description: Infrastructure for client Macs: a free local embedder for OpenClaw memory search. Installs or reuses Ollama (0.36.0 or newer, headless, no GUI, no sudo), pulls embeddinggemma-2:740m with num_ctx 8192 pinned on its own tag, points memory.search at http://127.0.0.1:11434 and re-indexes each agent once. Never touches Ollama Cloud sign-in, chat-model config or OLLAMA_* env. Runs from the fleet roll; not a client-facing feature.
